title: Background, Story, and Adaptations of Shakespeare's As You Like It
summary: Provides historical background on As You Like It, including its composition dates, first performance, literary influences, and later adaptations to TV and film. It also outlines the opening plot involving Orlando, the rivalry between Dukes Frederick and Senior, and how Rosalind and Orlando meet and fall in love.

title: Reading Preview: The Story So Far Before Act 1
summary: A story-recap box summarizing events up to this point: Sir Rowland de Boys' death, Oliver's refusal to educate Orlando, the brothers' physical confrontation, and a prediction task asking students what might happen next, followed by an activity book reference.

title: Act 1, Scene 1: Original Text, Modern English, and Narrative Summary
summary: Presents a parallel reading of Act 1, Scene 1 with Shakespeare's original language and its modern English translation. The scene shows Orlando confronting Oliver, demanding funds for education, followed by narrative summary covering the court's political situation, Charles the wrestler, and Oliver's plan to remove Orlando.

title: Reading Preview: The Story So Far Before Act 2
summary: A story-recap box summarizing Orlando's victory over Charles, his love at first sight with Rosalind, their exile to the forest of Arden, and Rosalind and Celia's disguises as Ganymede and Aliena, accompanied by a picture-reading prediction task and activity book instructions.

title: Act 2, Scenes 2 and 4: Original Text, Modern English, and Summary
summary: Offers parallel original and modern English readings from Act 2, Scenes 2 and 4, covering Duke Frederick's discovery of Touchstone's disappearance and Oliver's search orders. It also summarizes Rosalind and Celia eavesdropping on the shepherd Silvius as he talks about his love for Phoebe.

title: Reading Preview: The Story So Far Before Act 3
summary: A story-recap box covering Orlando and Adam's arrival in the forest, their invitation to dine with Duke Senior, Oliver's failed search for Orlando, and Orlando hanging love poems on trees. Includes a prediction task based on a picture and activity book exercise instructions.

title: Act 3, Scene 2: Original Text, Modern English, and Narrative Summary
summary: Presents a parallel reading of Act 3, Scene 2 in both Shakespeare's original language and modern English, covering Orlando's poetic declarations to Rosalind on the trees and Rosalind's disguise as Ganymede offering to cure Orlando of his lovesickness.

title: Reading Preview: The Story So Far Before Act 4
summary: A story-recap box summarizing Touchstone and Audrey's engagement, Rosalind's disappointment with Orlando, and Silvius' rejected confession to Phoebe. Includes a picture-based prediction task and references to Activity Book exercises for completion.
